title: Time-reversal-symmetry-breaking spin injection from a compensated magnet
title_zh: 来自补偿磁体的破时反演对称性的自旋注入
abstract: The generation and transport of spin currents are central to spintronics, a technologically relevant field in which information is carried and manipulated using the electron spin rather than solely the electrical charge. Conventionally, electrical spin injection and the separation of charge and spin currents rely either on ferromagnets1–10, in which spin polarization originates from a net magnetization, or on relativistic effects such as the spin Hall effect11–16. Here we demonstrate spin injection from Mn5Si3, a compensated magnet with vanishing net magnetization. Using lateral spin-valve devices, we electrically inject spins from Mn5Si3 into a non-magnetic channel and detect their propagation at a spatially separated ferromagnetic electrode. Switching between time-reversed magnetic states of Mn5Si3 reverses the detected spin signal, demonstrating that the spin injection breaks time-reversal symmetry. This behaviour is observed for two distinct electrical-biasing geometries, providing a characteristic signature that differs from conventional ferromagnetic and spin-Hall injection. Symmetry analysis, first-principles calculations and spin-transport modelling show that our observations are consistent with the altermagnetic order of Mn5Si3, in which spin-polarized currents can arise despite the absence of net magnetization17–21. The calculations yield spin polarizations of 6.5–10%, comparable to those of conventional ferromagnets, whereas the spin-transport modelling of the experiments indicates spin diffusion lengths of 50–130 nm. Our results provide experimental evidence that a compensated magnet can generate spin currents controlled by its magnetic order and demonstrate that the altermagnetic properties of Mn5Si3 enable spintronic functionality without net magnetization. Experiments show that altermagnetic Mn5Si3 generates spin currents despite zero net magnetization, demonstrating a central prediction of altermagnetic spintronics.
abstract_zh: 自旋电流的产生和输运是自旋电子学的核心，这是一个技术上相关的领域，其中信息利用电子自旋而不是仅仅利用电荷来承载和操纵。传统上，电自旋注入以及电流和自旋电流的分离要么依赖于铁磁体1–10（其中自旋极化源自净磁化），要么依赖于相对论效应，例如自旋霍尔效应11–16。在这里，我们展示了来自Mn5Si3的自旋注入，Mn5Si3是一种净磁化消失的补偿磁体。使用横向自旋阀器件，我们从Mn5Si3将自旋电注入非磁性通道，并在空间上分离的铁磁电极处检测其传播。在Mn5Si3之间切换时反演磁状态会反转检测到的自旋信号，表明自旋注入破坏了时间反演对称性。这种行为在两种不同的电偏置几何中被观察到，提供了与传统铁磁和自旋霍尔注入不同的特征签名。对称性分析、第一性原理计算和自旋输运建模表明，我们的观察与Mn5Si3的逆磁序一致，其中尽管没有净磁化，也可以产生自旋极化电流17–21。计算结果得出自旋极化为6.5–10%，与传统铁磁体相当，而实验的自旋输运建模表明自旋扩散长度为50–130 nm。我们的结果提供了实验证据，表明一种补偿磁体可以产生由其磁序控制的自旋电流，并表明Mn5Si3的逆磁性特性使得在没有净磁化的情况下也能实现自旋电子学功能。实验表明，逆磁Mn5Si3可以在零净磁化的情况下产生自旋电流，证明了逆磁自旋电子学的一个核心预测。
